summary: Phase 1 SignBridge burst-recognition validation complete. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass on /api/translate/sign-frame — W×4→W static conf≥0.5 (~0.85), L×3→L static, mixed B/L/Y (3 frames) → 200 with all keys, legacy image_base64:Y → Y (frames_analyzed=1), data:image/jpeg prefix accepted, empty body→422, 6 frames→422, unauth→401. Regression sign-to-text ['W']→'W' and empty signs→422 pass. Frontend web: login +52 5550001111 OTP 123456 succeeds, Traductor loads with translator-title, record-sign-btn visible, permission card renders (camera-view only appears with granted permission, expected in headless). Mode toggled 3× without crash/red-screen; text message sent successfully; zero console errors. Code inspection confirms SignCamera.tsx uses memo+forwardRef with autofocus={recording?'off':'on'}, and translator.tsx uses FRAME_INTERVAL_MS=400, BURST_SIZE=4, analyzeBurst sends frames array, buffer cleared on stop.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py sign_frame accepts both frames[] and legacy image_base64 gracefully; strips data-URL prefix and validates ≥100 bytes per frame — solid.
SignCamera.tsx memo comparator only checks recording — correct since the parent passes no other props; guarantees native preview stability.
translator.tsx: two independent intervals (capture 400ms, analyze 300ms) both cleared in stopFrameLoop; buffer explicitly reset on start and stop — good.
Minor: takePictureAsync in captureFrame uses base64 only on web (Platform.OS==='web'); on native the ImageManipulator downscale ensures small payloads. Acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable web flows (camera preview itself needs a native build to observe flicker; web parity flows all pass)

seed_data_creation: Uses OTP_TEST_NUMBERS +52 5550001111 test user; existing ASL JPEG fixtures at /app/backend/tests/fixtures/asl_{b,l,w,y}.jpg.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 flicker-fix + burst recognition is fully green on backend + web preview. Vision model gpt-5.4 recognized W and L correctly on the real ASL photos with confidence ≥0.5. Camera preview flicker itself cannot be measured in headless web (permission is not granted), but the SignCamera isolation (memo/forwardRef) and burst pipeline behave correctly. If a physical device test is needed later, use Expo Go with the QR from EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_sign_frame_burst.py is regression-safe (avoids OTP throttle by using 5550001111 only once per module).
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verified. Fix quality: preview isolation (memo comparator on recording prop) prevents parent re-renders from touching the CameraView node; burst mode gives the vision model temporal context to differentiate static fingerspelling (W) from dynamic gestures (water/agua) via the motion field; endpoint contract {sign,confidence,motion,frames_analyzed} is respected.
